AI Video Creator from Images — Initial Release

- Convert image collections (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB each) into 1080p MP4 videos using cloud GPU rendering.
- Simple API-based workflow: supports image upload, timeline edits, background music, text overlays, and aspect ratio selection.
- Session management with automatic token handling (anonymous users supported with free trial credits).
- Fast processing (30–90 seconds typical) with status updates and progress feedback.
- Supports media export (MP4, MOV, AVI, WEBM, MKV, JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC).
- Friendly for social media and marketing video creation.
